exit_reason: HISTORIAN pass complete for CQL-05. Three issues were found, fixed, and regression-tested with no open defects.

config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-05: CQL - Type Operators - Structural. This HISTORIAN pass independently tested As<T>, Children, Convert to<T>, Descendants, and Is<T> with native-loaded and forced Python fallback DuckDB registrations.

issues.title: Choice<T...> and Tuple {...} type specifiers were parsed but not accepted by structural is/as translation
issues.evidence: translate_cql failed with Unknown expression type for ChoiceTypeSpecifier and TupleTypeSpecifier in CQL structural is/as targets.
issues.resolution: Added ChoiceTypeSpecifier and TupleTypeSpecifier handling to structural target validation, static type naming, structural conformance, and is/as routing.

issues.title: Children()/Descendants() erased primitive identity through VARCHAR[] encoding
issues.evidence: First(Children({ a: 1 })) is Integer and First(Children({ a: true })) is Boolean both returned false; First(Children({ a: '1' })) as Integer returned 1.
issues.resolution: Internal structural traversal encodes primitive child items with CQL type tags and translator is/as checks consume those tags for structural child items.

issues.title: convert Quantity to String bypassed QuantityToString
issues.evidence: convert 5 'mg' to String lowered to generic ToString(parse_quantity(...)) instead of the CQL quantity string path used by ToString(5 'mg').
issues.resolution: convert ... to String now lowers Quantity-shaped operands through QuantityToString(parse_quantity(...)).
